timeline.summary: Suniel advises the dryad sisters to seek direct contact with the Worldsoul and devises a theory to bind them to a tree.
timeline.quote: He advised them to try to achieve direct contact with the Worldsoul

citation.work: Suniel
citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Suniel binds the sisters' essence within a tree and they reach the Worldsoul, who commands them to grow an army.
timeline.quote: Suniel bound their essence within a tree

citation.work: Suniel
citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mat'Selesnya completes the spell, bonding the dryads to all trees of Ravnica; Suniel cannot save them.
timeline.quote: watch helplessly as the three sisters disappeared into the oaks

citation.work: Suniel
citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three dryad sisters, Cim, Oba and Ses, try to make contact with Mat'Selesnya in a trance and report that she is in a giant web but cannot be reached.
timeline.quote: She's there in that giant web, I know it.

citation.work: The Great Concourse
citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Suniel proposes binding the dryads to a tree so they can draw power to reach the Lattice.
timeline.quote: I have an idea,

citation.work: The Great Concourse
citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Suniel binds the sisters to the roots of an oak; they enter the Lattice and reach each other's minds.
timeline.quote: Then Suniel's magic flowed into them.

citation.work: The Great Concourse
citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mat'Selesnya warns that the sisters will bond with all the trees of Ravnica and can never return; Cim agrees.
timeline.quote: Cim looked at her sisters. "We understand, Great Mother."

citation.work: The Great Concourse
citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The roots absorb the three dryads into the oaks while Suniel watches helplessly.
timeline.quote: watch helplessly as the three sisters disappeared into the oaks.

citation.work: The Great Concourse
citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The three dryads appear grown from the World Tree in the great hall of Vitu-Ghazi as the new guildmaster, and Suniel realizes the Cim he knew is no more.
timeline.quote: Little did they know that they would gaze upon their new guildmaster for the first time.

citation.work: The Great Concourse
citation.text: "The Great Concourse". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The three dryad sisters enter a trance to reconnect with Mat'Selesnya; Suniel binds them to an old oak and the Parun fuses them with the World Tree, creating Trostani.
timeline.quote: this old Parun fused the three dryads with the World Tree, creating Trostani.

citation.work: Trostani
citation.text: "Trostani", section "Creation of Trostani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mistress Cim awakes and persuades Mistress Ses to restore Trostani's harmony, and Selesnya joins the other guilds against Bolas.
timeline.quote: It is the will of Mat'Selesnya that the Conclave join the other guilds to defeat Nicol Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Trostani appears as three dryads from the oak and agrees to let Kaya consult the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Three dryads, each one an individual, and collectively the singular entity through which the Worldsoul of Ravnica was said to speak.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Trostani's three faces show conflicting reactions.
timeline.quote: She said nothing, only continued looking back, the expressions on her three faces completely out of alignment.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba breaks her calm and admits she killed the guild leaders because they deserved it.
timeline.quote: Because they deserved it

timeline.summary: Oba says she took the corruption of Realmbreaker into herself during the invasion.
timeline.quote: I fought the corruption of Realmbreaker alone.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia attempts to arrest Oba, who points out her sisters cannot be held responsible.
timeline.quote: I formally place you, Oba of Selesnya, under arrest.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba incapacitates her sisters Cim and Ses.
timeline.quote: Her sisters went limp, sagging on their single trunk like wilted flowers

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction

timeline.summary: Oba separates from her sisters, ending Trostani as a unified being.
timeline.quote: Farther and farther from them she pulled herself, until she was, while still attached to the tree itself, an entirely independent entity, Trostani no longer.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba is bound and the room goes still; Ses and Cim put Oba to sleep.
timeline.quote: Each of them pressed a hand to her temple, and she went limp.

timeline.summary: Cim says the Guildpact has no way to sever Oba, who remains their sister, and that a rotten branch must be removed.
timeline.quote: Oba remains one-third of us; we have no way to sever her.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Cim says Trostani will go into communion with Mat'Selesnya to learn whether she wants them to remain, and Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave.
timeline.quote: Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave while we are in communion

timeline.quote: Vitu-Ghazi is not fallen.
